scope: public API at pinned deps/upstream.toml revision; not a proof of ABI equivalence

groups.note: Converts shapes, triangular parts, conjugates, and coefficients.

Fortran GEMMT/GEMMTR write only the selected triangle; SYR2/HER2 compose native rank products with signed strides and ignore the old Hermitian diagonal imaginary component. Fortran GEMM3M remains ordinary native complex GEMM arithmetic compatibility. CBLAS GEMM3M composes three native real products with staged operands; this is not an optimized native 3M kernel and intermediate sums can overflow or lose precision.

Connects the 12 Fortran symbols of TRTRS/TRTRI/TRTI2 to both ABIs using native solve/inverse. The unit diagonal is preserved without being read. TRTRS/TRTRI check for a singular diagonal, and TRTI2 defines no positive INFO. This does not change the paths of the existing BLAS TRSM/TRSV.
Requires converting the final permutation to LAPACK's sequential IPIV. Does not guarantee that getf2/getrf2 run the same algorithm.

groups.api: FullPivLu rank truncation + guarded triangular solve / matmul
groups.note: Connects the eight Fortran symbols of GETC2/GESC2 to both ABIs. Stops native LU before a pivot that needs perturbation and continues with guarded elimination. Converts row/column permutations to sequential IPIV/JPIV, and GESC2 manages SCALE at every step. C API is connected separately.
Conjugately transforms upper-triangular input to lower-triangular form and converts INFO

Eight Fortran symbols, four types, and both ABIs are connected. The adapter controls pivoting together with LAPACK TOL/INFO/PIV and composes a native LLT and a native GEMM Schur update for each pivot. The automatic tolerance is N*DLAMCH(E)*largest diagonal. It stops at TOL after the first positive pivot and returns the completed factors, the uncomputed permuted triangle, and the stopping diagonal. PSTRF/PSTF2 share the sequential path and allocate internal matrices and scratch.

Connects 32 Fortran symbols for real SY / complex HE to both ABIs. Converts the native split D and final permutation to classic IPIV and interleaved A, and also reads external factors. UPLO=U is handled with a reversed basis. TRF/TF2, TRS/TRS2, TRI/TRI2/TRI2X, and SV share the native path and internal scratch. TRF/SV query is 1, TRI2 query is max(1,N), and NB for TRI2X is a hint. Complex symmetric SY is out of scope.

Connects 20 Fortran symbols for real SY / complex HE to both ABIs. Uses public Rook pivoting and converts the two swap indices of each two-column block separately into ROOK IPIV. Verifies bidirectional solve/inverse with external LAPACK factors and reconstruction from element matrices. TRF/SV query and minimum caller work are 1, and internal scratch is natively owned. Symmetric congruence scaling for subnormal rows and common scaling for D/RHS blocks avoid native #212. LAPACKE waits for the shared conversion in #288. No claim of the same algorithm, pivot columns, or performance as the dedicated Fortran routines. Complex symmetric SY has a separate contract.

evidence.storage: dense self-adjoint native factor; Fortran dense/packed conversion requires an adapter
evidence.method: Reviewed the public PivotingStrategy enum, public LbltParams.pivoting field, cholesky_in_place contract and the real/complex rook tests in the owning module.
evidence.reason: Public rook numerical capability is present; this is a representation candidate, not proof of LAPACK ROOK ABI or pivot interoperability.

groups.note: Fortran GEQRT/GEQRT2/GEQRT3/GEMQRT are connected for four types and both ABIs. Converts coefficients from each active column of the native QR and constructs the LAPACK T. GEQRT3 uses the common path rather than a recursive algorithm. Allocates internal arrays.

groups.api: native compact-WY QR panels / Householder block application / modified LU with native matmul and triangular solve
groups.note: Twenty-eight Fortran symbols connected for both integer ABIs. LATSQR stores separate T blocks for the initial row panel and each subsequent [R;B] panel, preserving earlier reflectors. TSQR Q generation/application gathers the correct noncontiguous row/column blocks. GEQR implements the five-entry header, optimal/minimal TSIZE/LWORK queries and compact fallback; GEMQR reads external GEQR metadata. ORHR_COL/UNHR_COL reconstruct Q through modified LU of Q-[D;0], native trailing updates and native triangular solves. GETSQRHRT composes TSQR, explicit thin Q, reconstruction and D*R. Internal temporary storage is owned by the adapter; ORGTSQR_ROW uses the common explicit-Q path and does not claim the reference in-place row algorithm. C API is separate.

groups.api: reversed native-backed QR / adjoint QR LQ / prefix Householder application
groups.note: Forty-eight Fortran symbols connected for both integer ABIs. Both axes are reversed around existing standard QR/LQ, then triangular placement and TAU order are reversed back. QL uses H(k)...H(1); complex RQ uses H(1)^H...H(k)^H with conjugated row-vector storage. Thin Q uses the last columns (QL) or rows (RQ). Generation snapshots only stored reflector tails, and application skips zero coefficients and validates only active prefix extents. Blocked/unblocked names share an unblocked composition and own temporary storage; they do not claim dedicated native QL/RQ APIs or reference blocking performance. C API is separate.
Converts U/V and LAPACK's VT, full/thin/overwrite, and the workspace query. Does not reproduce gesvd/gesdd as separate Netlib algorithms
A/I/V selection, descending S, U/VT, query and minimum work are connected for four types and both integer ABIs; native failure uses the saved ILP64 driver.

groups.api: column-pivoted QR + native SVD + Q application
groups.note: JOBA=A/M/H use QR rank truncation with row pivoting, R transpose and full/thin/rank/factored vectors. JOBA=E condition estimation uses the saved ILP64 expert driver; native failure also falls back.
Not exported by this adapter. Existing LAPACK backend remains responsible; ordinary native SVD is not substituted for Jacobi sweeps or expert accuracy modes.

groups.api: native bidiag panels / LAPACK reflector gauge / native GEMV updates
groups.note: Connects 20 Fortran symbols to both ABIs. Normalizes each active column/row, uses the single-column panel of native bidiag_in_place, and converts complex beta and the reciprocal-coefficient convention to LAPACK's real D/E, complex TAUQ/TAUP, and stored vectors. GEBRD/GEBD2 share the unblocked composition. LABRD updates its owned working matrix in sequence, preserving caller A22 while returning the first NB rows/columns and the deferred X/Y. Q/P are generated and applied left/right from the same storage form with native GEMV and rank-one updates. Handles the minimum length and query of caller WORK but allocates internal storage separately. Verifies four types, both ABIs, upper/lower bidiagonal form, rectangular shapes, and interoperability with external factors. C ABI is a separate task.
Bidiagonal SVD is available. Range selection, the LAPACK compact representation, and a specific dqds/QR algorithm are not independent APIs

The public native API provides eigenvalues, left/right eigenvectors, and balancing. GEEVX condition estimation is not in the native API, so Fortran SENSE=E/V/B prefers the saved backend with the same integer ABI and converts integers to ILP64 if there is no original LP64 implementation. An original ILP64 GEEVX for all four types is required before registration; if missing, initialization fails before LBT is changed. SENSE=N remains native.

Connects the eight Fortran symbols of GEBAL/GEBAK to both ABIs. Converts the native final permutation/scaling to the ILO/IHI/SCALE swap encoding and distinguishes left from right back-transformation. C API is connected separately
Converts UPLO, real eigenvalues, and the workspace. The computation path is not identical across the individual LAPACK drivers

groups.api: self_adjoint_evd and selection from the full spectrum
groups.note: Partial ranges can be filtered from the full spectrum. There is no direct API for MRRR, Sturm count, or inverse iteration

Four scalar types and both integer ABIs implement A/I/V, IFAIL, minimum workspace and query. Nonpositive ABSTOL uses native full EVD, without claiming Sturm/MRRR/inverse iteration. Positive ABSTOL and native failures use a saved ILP64 expert driver.

groups.api: tridiag_in_place / normalized Householder + native gemv / Hermitian rank-2
groups.note: Twenty Fortran symbols connected for both integer ABIs. Ordinary real reductions use native tridiagonalization in its safe scale range; complex real-E gauge and extreme real scales compose normalized native Householder panels with native matrix-vector and Hermitian rank-2 updates. Upper/lower storage, real D/E, Q generation/application and LATRD deferred W panels are adapted explicitly. Internal temporary storage is owned by the adapter; TRD accepts minimum LWORK=1, without claiming the reference blocked algorithm. C API is tracked separately.

Connects the 14 Fortran symbols of STEV/STEVD/STEQR/STEDC/STERF to both ABIs. Handles post-multiplication by an existing Q and the workspace query with the minimum WORK. On native non-convergence, passes control to the saved ILP64 LAPACK and keeps partial results

groups.api: tridiagonal_self_adjoint_evd and selection from the full spectrum
groups.note: Connects the 12 Fortran symbols of STEVR/STEVX/STEGR/STEMR to both ABIs. Selects A/I/V from the native full spectrum, using an algorithm different from dedicated MRRR. STEMR's TRYRAC=true, positive ABSTOL for STEVR/STEVX, and native non-convergence are delegated to the saved ILP64 LAPACK. C API is connected separately

Connects the four Fortran symbols of PTEQR to both ABIs. Builds the bidiagonal Cholesky factor of the positive-definite tridiagonal matrix and uses the native bidiagonal SVD. Handles descending eigenvalues, the positive-definiteness INFO, and post-multiplication by an existing Q, delegating SVD non-convergence to the saved LAPACK. C API is connected separately

Re-review target because the confirmation record for the old unsupported classification is insufficient. Does not assert that the semantic public contract, types, storage formats, and options are confirmed absent. Old note: no independent public API for Sturm-count bisection and inverse iteration

prior_assessment.note: No independent public API for Sturm-count bisection and inverse iteration

groups.note: Connects the 12 Fortran symbols of SYGV/HEGV, GVD, and GVX to both ABIs. Composes ITYPE=1/2/3, UPLO, B normalization, and range selection. GV/GVD use a common native EVD; GVX selects from the full spectrum, with positive ABSTOL and native failures delegated to the saved ILP64 LAPACK. C API is connected separately

Connects the eight Fortran symbols of SYGST/SYGS2/HEGST/HEGS2 to both ABIs. Reads the factorized B; ITYPE=1 uses a triangular solve and 2/3 use triangular matmul to form the standard form. GS2/GST share the native kernel. C API is connected separately

Connects 20 Fortran symbols, four types, and both ABIs. Composes the native Schur factorization of the active block and the basis change, updates the existing Z, and handles the GEES SELECT callback, real conjugate pairs, SDIM, and reordering. HSEQR/LAHQR/LAQR0/LAQR4 share the native path and do not reproduce Netlib's per-entry QR algorithm selection. Allocates internal arrays; on non-convergence, because the public API returns no partial indices, reports the whole active range as non-converged with INFO=IHI.

Connects eight Fortran symbols, four types, and both ABIs. TRSEN JOB=N performs stable selection with native Schur block moves, plus M, eigenvalue extraction, and Q updates. GEESX SENSE=N uses the existing native GEES path. On rejected swaps, SDIM returns the total number of selected columns rather than the moved prefix (the common GEES handling is fixed too). No public native API exists for S/SEP or RCONDE/RCONDV, so JOB/SENSE E/V/B are delegated to the saved original ILP64 routines. For LP64, only written IWORK/BWORK slots are converted, and the SELECT callback converts the LOGICAL ABI with a thread-local guard, restoring it after nested calls. TRSEN handles only LWORK=-1, and real GEESX performs the collective LWORK/LIWORK query. Allocates internally owned matrices and scratch. C ABI is a separate task.

Connects eight Fortran symbols, four types, and both ABIs. The right side uses the public Schur eigenvector helper, and the left side is generated from a reversed transpose/adjoint Schur form and then restored to the original column order. Converts SIDE L/R/B, HOWMNY A/B/S, normalization of real 2x2 pairs in SELECT and M/MM, back-transformation, packing of real conjugate pairs, and max-component normalization. TREVC3 shares the same native helper and matrix products and does not claim its own blocked back-substitution algorithm. The query returns the minimum WORK/RWORK of this composed path, and internally owned matrices/scratch are O(n^2). On native rejection it delegates to the saved original ILP64 TREVC/TREVC3, converting LP64 SELECT/M/INFO. C ABI is a separate task.

Connects six Fortran symbols: TREXC for four types and LAEXC for the two real types, both integer ABIs. Converts 1x1/2x2 exchanges in the public checked Schur move, arbitrary move distances, Q updates, the leading-row correction and final position of real IFST/ILST, preservation of complex index input, and the last successful state on rejection. Preserves LAEXC's zero-block quick return and fixed WORK. Allocates the owned Schur matrix and the required Q. C ABI is a separate task.

Connects 12 Fortran symbols, four types, and both ABIs. Converts the native GEVD homogeneous alpha/beta and left/right eigenvectors. Flips the imaginary columns of conjugate pairs in the real transpose-left form to match LAPACK adjoint-left and normalizes by the max-component norm. Each driver shares the native path and allocates internal arrays and scratch.

Connects four Fortran symbols, four types, and both ABIs. BALANC=N/SENSE=N composes native GEVD with ILO/IHI, LSCALE/RSCALE, Schur A/B in the original scale, and ABNRM/BBNRM. Other balance/condition modes are delegated to the saved existing ILP64 backend, converting integer scalars and owned IWORK/BWORK for LP64 calls. An ILP64 expert backend is required before loading, and a missing one is diagnosed before registration.

Connects 16 Fortran symbols, four types, and both ABIs. Converts the HGEQZ active range and Q/Z=N/I/V, the dense reduction of GGES/GGES3/GEGS, homogeneous alpha/beta, SELECT and real conjugate pairs, and SDIM. Preserves beta=0. Because the native API does not return a non-convergence state, the structure and outputs are validated, and an incomplete result reports the whole active range as non-converged with INFO=IHI. Re-evaluates QZ after reordering. Allocates internal arrays and scratch and provides the minimum legal WORK and query for each entry point.

Connects eight Fortran symbols, four types, and both ABIs. TGSEN IJOB=0 and GGESX SENSE=N are native. All blocks are selected for real conjugate pairs, and homogeneous alpha/beta for TGSEN is taken from the saved factors. Condition and separation estimates are delegated to the retained existing ILP64 LAPACK, converting LP64 SELECT/IWORK/BWORK and the callback LOGICAL width. Allocates internal matrices and scratch and converts WORK/IWORK queries and minimum sizes.

Connects eight Fortran symbols, four types, and both ABIs. Passes the active block to the public generalized_hessenberg and converts its coupling with the outside range and COMPQ/COMPZ=N/I/V with native GEMM. Never reads the strict lower triangle of B and zeroes it in the output. GGHRD/GGHD3 share the native path and allocate internal matrices and scratch. The minimum WORK and query for GGHD3 are 1.

Connects eight Fortran symbols, four types, and both ABIs. Converts block swaps/rejections and positions from the public generalized reorder_schur to Fortran indices and returns S/T together with the final valid state of the requested Q/Z. Handles real 1x1/2x2 and complex 1x1 blocks, the real TGEXC query, and the minimum WORK of real TGEX2, which has no query. Allocates internal matrices and scratch separately.
Generalized eigenvectors exist, but the same contract as an independent helper from an existing Schur pencil is not connected

groups.api: native-backed QR/RQ, reflector apply, triangular solve composition
groups.note: Connects 16 Fortran symbols, four types, and both ABIs. GGQRF/GGRQF compose existing QR/RQ and Q application and return reflectors compatible with external ORG/UNGQR/RQ. GGLSE/GGGLM compute equality-constrained and minimum-norm solutions from the same factors and distinguish two kinds of exact triangular rank failure as INFO=1/2. Handles queries, minimum WORK, and destructive C/D payloads. Makes no claim of a dedicated public driver, rank-revealing determination, or the same algorithm/performance as Netlib, and allocates internal matrices, coefficients, and scratch separately.
Implementable as basic operations. Most current paths use loops in the Rust compatibility layer rather than dedicated colmat-rs kernels

groups.api: MatRef::min/max/sum + real-precision abs1 and first-index selection
groups.note: Fourteen Fortran symbols connected for both integer ABIs. Real MAX/MIN/SUM borrow strided vectors; absolute extrema and IAMIN allocate real comparison values and use native min/max. Complex IAMIN compares abs(real)+abs(imag), rounded in the real input precision, and returns the first 1-based logical index. Negative strides return zero without reading X; zero stride returns the first (absolute) value for extrema and zero for SUM/IAMIN.
Arithmetic-compatible entry point for the existing ROT. Modified Givens ROTMG/ROTM are different.

Twenty-eight Fortran symbols connected for both integer ABIs. Convert native sine conjugation/sign and real r conventions; compose shifted rotations and batched one-/two-sided applications, including LASR pivot and direction. Scale real generators and shifted product ratios safely. Complex LAR2V ignores diagonal imaginary components. ROTM/ROTMG remain separate.

Re-review target because the confirmation record for the old unsupported classification is insufficient. Does not assert that the semantic public contract, types, storage formats, and options are confirmed absent. Old note: no public API for modified Givens rotation

prior_assessment.note: No public API for modified Givens rotation

groups.api: real modulus reductions / induced row-column sums / normalized native norm_l2
groups.note: Fifty-four Fortran symbols connected for both integer ABIs across dense, Hessenberg, tridiagonal, symmetric/Hermitian, triangular, band, packed and RFP storage. Complex M/1/I use modulus, not native component-max or abs1; F/E retain components and normalize before native l2 to avoid the pinned extreme-range defect. Unit diagonals and ignored Hermitian imaginary components are not read. RFP N/T/C and NaN/Inf behavior are tested. Temporary storage is allocated internally; caller WORK is preserved.

groups.api: native strided copy/map/fill, row/column swaps, real component GEMM
groups.note: Connects Fortran copy, permutation, safe-range LASCL, precision conversion, mixed products, and matrix-copy extensions to both ABIs. Narrowing conversions implement per-component upper-bound checks and INFO=1, distinguishing them from a plain cast or saturation. IMATCOPY uses a native snapshot, and LACRM/LARCM use two real GEMM operations. C API is a separate ABI connection task.

Connects four Fortran types and LP64/ILP64. LAPACK coefficients, real beta, and the positive gauge are generated by the Rust adapter, and application composes native GEMV/SYMV/GEMM. Converts F/B and C/R storage. LARFB allocates internal work arrays. CBLAS/LAPACKE connections are separate.

Connects the eight Fortran symbols of LAUUM/LAUU2 to both ABIs. Constructs the product of the borrowed triangular factor with its transpose/conjugate using native triangular::matmul and updates only the specified triangle. C API is connected separately

Eight packed/RFP Fortran inverse symbols connected for both integer ABIs. Selected triangles are staged into owned dense storage and passed to native triangular inverse. RFP N/T/C and odd/even layouts are converted; unit diagonals are not read or overwritten. Singular diagonal INFO leaves the input unchanged. Internal storage is O(n^2); C API is separate.

groups.api: native interval matmul / packed outer products / triangular_solve
groups.note: Connects 44 Fortran BLAS symbols to both ABIs. Passes only the stored band/packed interval to native multiplication and distinguishes negative strides, complex symmetric versus Hermitian, real diagonals, and the unit diagonal. Triangular solves compose the interval's native dot product and a diagonal solve, and zero columns in the no-transpose case are skipped as in the reference Netlib. No full dense expansion; allocates internal storage for the X snapshot of the product and the necessary row gathers. C ABI is a separate task.

groups.api: native column PartialPivLu / rank-one matmul / interval triangular_solve
groups.note: Connects 32 Fortran symbols to both ABIs. Factors the stored band columns with native LU and preserves LAPACK's interleaved IPIV and fill-in through row exchanges and skew-strided outer-product updates. Converts tridiagonal systems to an O(n) four-row band region and reads/writes DL/D/DU/DU2 and adjacent pivots. Supports N/T/C solves from external factors. GTSV also handles its own DL contract, stopping at the first singular pivot and preserving the partial B and second superdiagonal. No full dense expansion. C ABI is a separate task.

Connects 16 Fortran symbols to both ABIs. Processes only the stored interval with native LLT, triangular solves, and selected-triangle rank updates, without full dense expansion. PBTRF/PBTF2 share the unblocked composition and do not claim a dedicated blocked band kernel. Verifies upper/lower storage, real diagonals, the non-positive-definite INFO, and solves interoperating with external factors. Allocates an O(min(kd,n)) vector snapshot internally. C ABI is a separate task.

groups.api: native LDL panels / unit band triangular_solve / real matmul
groups.note: Connects 16 Fortran symbols to both ABIs. Preserves real D and real/complex E, normalizes each column by a power of two, and uses the determined first column of the native LDL panel and the native real Schur update. Solves compose an O(n) unit band with a real diagonal solve and distinguish complex upper/lower conjugation. No full dense expansion. Verifies reuse of external factors, non-positive-definite INFO and partial output, tiny/huge values, empty/zero RHS, and mixed ABIs. The reference complex PTTS2 rewrite for a zero RHS and its N=1 reciprocal overflow are documented as separate reproducers; the native implementation avoids touching unused arrays and keeps finite solutions through normalization. C ABI is a separate task.

groups.api: native LDL factor / solve / inverse + LAPACK pivot conversion
groups.note: Sixteen real-symmetric/complex-Hermitian packed Fortran symbols connected for both integer ABIs. Selected packed triangles are staged into owned dense storage, sharing native LDL and LAPACK 1x1/2x2 IPIV conversion with dense Bunch-Kaufman. Factor, solve, inverse and driver preserve packed boundaries and RHS padding; Hermitian diagonal imaginary components are not read. Complex-symmetric SP is not claimed. Internal temporary storage is owned by the adapter; no caller workspace query is defined for these routines. C API is separate.

groups.api: dense expansion / native full-spectrum self-adjoint EVD
groups.note: Connects 24 Fortran symbols to both ABIs. Expands the specified band/packed interval into an owned O(n^2) Hermitian matrix and uses the native full EVD. BEV/BEVD and PEV/PEVD share a path and do not claim dedicated band/packed algorithms. VX selects A/I/V from the full spectrum, band Q returns all eigenvectors, and AB returns the diagonalized tridiagonal matrix. Positive ABSTOL, native failures, and range endpoints inside the precision-based guard are passed to the saved ILP64 expert driver, converting LP64 integer arrays. Preserves the workspace query and minimum legal work but allocates the native internal region separately. C ABI is a separate task.

Connects 24 Fortran symbols, four types, and both ABIs. Packed input stores a triangular Cholesky factor and band input the PBSTF split factor; composes the congruence transformation, native full EVD, and B normalization. GVD also uses the common native EVD and does not claim the identically named divide-and-conquer algorithm. GVX selects A/I/V; the band full-basis Q returns generalized eigenvectors, and AB returns the diagonal tridiagonal form. Positive ABSTOL, native failures, and precision-guarded range endpoints are delegated to the saved original ILP64 driver, converting only written LP64 IWORK/IFAIL slots. Allocates an O(n^2) owned matrix and scratch. C ABI is a separate task.

groups.api: native tridiag / Householder generation and application
groups.note: Connects 16 Fortran symbols, four types, and both ABIs. SPTRD/HPTRD expand packed storage into an owned dense matrix and convert the real beta gauge of the existing native tridiagonalization to LAPACK AP/TAU form. OPGTR/UPGTR/OPMTR/UPMTR read only the valid tail of the packed reflector and share native Householder application. Zero coefficients in the tail, diagonal, and tridiagonal entries are not referenced when forming or applying Q. SBTRD/HBTRD expand the band and compose the same reduction, returning D/E with Q for VECT=V and X*Q for VECT=U. VECT=N does not reference Q. Complex band E is phase-adjusted to be nonnegative. Verifies fixed WORK, INFO, and storage guards. Internally owned matrices are O(n^2); no claim of the same performance as a dedicated band bulge chase. C ABI is a separate task.

Twelve band/packed/RFP Fortran solve symbols connected for both integer ABIs. Selected triangles are staged into owned dense storage for native triangular solves; right-sided TFSM uses transposed native views. Band width, packed/RFP coordinates, complex transpose/conjugation and unit diagonals are explicit. TBTRS/TPTRS check singular diagonals before solving, including zero RHS columns. TFSM alpha=0 avoids A and old B reads. Internal dense storage is O(n^2); C API is separate.

Connects the four Fortran entry points SSFRK/DSFRK/CHFRK/ZHFRK to both ABIs. Converts RFP odd/even, UPLO, real N/T versus complex N/C, and rank-k transpose. Allocates an O(n^2) internal native matrix. beta=0 uses the old C, and a zero product does not read A. The Hermitian diagonal reads only the real part, and the output imaginary part is zero. This is not a classification asserting that dedicated native RFP APIs of the same name exist.

groups.api: factorized triangular/split B + native triangular_solve / matmul / reflectors
groups.note: Connects eight Fortran symbols, four types, and both ABIs. Packed GST reads an external triangular Cholesky factor and applies the congruence transformation for ITYPE=1/2/3. Band GST reads the PBSTF split factor S and, through native block triangular solves and reflector composition, forms C=X^H A X and X^H B X=I within the original bandwidth. Preserves the unspecified triangle, padding, and BB, and reads only the real part of the complex Hermitian diagonal. Allocates dense internal matrices and does not claim the same performance as a dedicated band bulge chase. Band native rejections use the saved ILP64 driver. C ABI is a separate task.

groups.note: Candidate for composing the application of multiple Givens rotations. Requires conversion of array coefficients and the pivot/direction convention
Interprets band/packed/RFP/tridiagonal storage to construct the norm. Note the difference between induced 1/infinity norms and elementwise norms

groups.api: borrowed strided MatRef/MatMut copy and conjugation
groups.note: Connects the 24 Fortran symbols of TR/TP/TF to both ABIs. Reads and writes only triangular regions and converts RFP odd/even, UPLO, real N/T, complex N/C, and folded conjugation. Does not expand to full dense storage.

groups.api: native column magnitude maps, diagonal copies, GEMV and BIN iteration
groups.note: Connects 38 Fortran symbols to both ABIs. Verifies GEEQU/GBEQU abs1, safe range, and zero-matrix diagnostics; the radix variant coefficients/AMAX; and the PO/PB/PP diagonal readout and SCOND. SYEQUB/HEEQUB implement BIN iteration with native GEMV and normalize the exponent range. This is not a classification asserting independent native APIs of the same name. Allocates internal memory and preserves caller WORK.

groups.api: native-backed QR of triangular-pentagonal stacks / compact Householder factor and application
groups.note: Twenty-eight Fortran symbols connected for both integer ABIs. QR stages the selected upper triangle and pentagonal tail; LQ uses the adjoint stack. Standard Householder QR and compact block factors preserve LAPACK reflector conventions. Block application supports left/right, forward/backward, column/row storage and normal/adjoint operations, ignoring structural zeros and the unused triangle. Blocked names compose native-backed operations with owned temporary storage; they do not claim dedicated triangular-pentagonal kernels or reference blocking performance. No entry has a workspace query; factor2 has no WORK argument. C API remains separate.

Connects the four Fortran symbols of ORM22/UNM22 to both ABIs. Distinguishes the row partition (N1,N2) and column partition (N2,N1) of Q and applies the lower part of Q12 and the upper part of Q21 with native triangular matmul. Does not read the unspecified triangle or leading-dimension padding. Handles left/right, real N/T, complex N/C, and empty blocks, allocating an O(m*n) internal result in the same form as C and copying it back at the end. The query is m*n, and the minimum work for the actual computation is NQ as in the reference execution code (1 for empty blocks). Even at the minimum length, native internal storage is needed separately. C ABI is a separate task.

Connects 36 Fortran symbols, four types, and both ABIs. Provides A/TAU coefficient conversion, Q formation and left/right application, and GEQRS. The complex ordinary and nonnegative-diagonal variants generate LAPACK-gauge reflectors and preserve real beta. Allocates internal arrays, and no guarantee is made that each entry point uses the same Netlib implementation as its algorithm name.

groups.api: QR / reflector application / residual column norms
groups.note: Connects four Fortran types and LP64/ILP64. GEQP3/GEQPF convert fixed JPVT and the permutation direction. GEQP3RK recomputes residual column norms and implements early termination via KMAX/ABSTOL/RELTOL together with updates to the accompanying right-hand side. Distinguishes this from native rank determination by diagonal values. Allocates internal work arrays.

Connects 56 Fortran symbols, four types, and both ABIs. Constructs A/TAU and the row-stored T from the adjoint QR. Short-wide panels factor [L B] in stages and interoperate with external T. GELQ chooses the legal MB=1 header form. Allocates internal arrays, and GELQT3 uses the common path.

groups.api: Householder generation / native GEMV and GEMM
groups.note: Connects 32 Fortran symbols, four types, and both ABIs. Constructs the upper-trapezoidal [R 0]Z and sparse reflectors. LARZT/LARZB provide the backward and row-preserving behavior specified by LAPACK. Handles conjugation of complex T and overlap between implicit components and the tail, and does not read the central region on which they do not act. Allocates internal arrays.

groups.api: QR / LQ / SVD / RZ / triangular solve
groups.note: Connects 28 Fortran symbols, four types, and both ABIs. Full-rank cases use QR/LQ, GELSS/GELSD use the common native SVD, and GELSY/GELSX use fixed-column QR and RZ for a complete orthogonal factorization. The leading-R condition test uses singular values and therefore has a different rounding path from Netlib's incremental estimate. Converts scaling, rank, residuals, and the layout of B, and allocates internal arrays.

Connects 16 Fortran symbols, four types, and both ABIs. Composes Hessenberg reduction and explicit Q formation/left-right application from LAPACK-gauge reflectors and native application. Handles ILO/IHI partial ranges and interoperates with external A/TAU. GEHRD/GEHD2 share the path and allocate internal arrays.

Connects four Fortran symbols to both ABIs. Composes split Cholesky by eliminating the second half in reverse order, updating the first half, and then factorizing the first half forward. This is not a replacement by ordinary POTRF; A=S^H*S is reconstructed independently from the upper, lower, and crossing parts of S. The split point is min(n,(n+kd)/2), and nonexistent columns are not read even with an excess declared width. The difference that the reference PBSTF reads out-of-range columns when m>n is documented as a separate reproducer. C ABI is a separate task.

Connects 28 Fortran symbols to both ABIs. Converts packed/RFP triangular storage into an owned O(n^2) work matrix and uses native LLT and Cholesky solves. The inverse is obtained by solving with an identity matrix natively and restoring the stored triangle. Handles UPLO, real N/T versus complex N/C, odd/even RFP, and folded-block conjugation, without reading the imaginary diagonal. Verifies solve/inverse interoperability with external factors, the non-positive-definite INFO, and empty/zero RHS. Caller storage is not shared with the opposite-triangle scratch of native LLT. C ABI is a separate task.

scalar_overrides.note: Scope of review: the public Bunch-Kaufman factor/solve has a complex Hermitian LDL^H contract. It differs from the SY/SP family that passes complex symmetric LDL^T and its IPIV/factors. Does not conclude that the same compact factor contract can be obtained from a general LU.

evidence.storage: Fortran complex-symmetric dense/packed upper/lower compact LDL^T with block IPIV
evidence.options: SY/SP factorization, solve, inverse and rook variants; transpose symmetry rather than Hermitian adjoint symmetry
evidence.method: Read the public Bunch-Kaufman module equation P A P^T=L B L^H, the factor kernel conjugated updates and real diagonals, and the solve conjugation contract. Compared the required LDL^T factor payload semantically; a generic complex signature or a general LU solver does not establish that contract.
evidence.reason: The reviewed public factor/solve family requires self-adjoint input and adjoint factors; complex transpose-symmetric compact factors are not exposed by it. This is bounded to the named family and options, not a statement that the mathematics cannot be implemented.
